Hi Ava / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, Vectra is planning a capacity uplift (+50% token throughput) and a one-year term amendment to start the new capacity on Aug 1. I’m sending the mutual action plan and a lightweight provisioning matrix to get the engineering & procurement checks underway. Attachments: Vectra_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, provisioning_matrix.csv.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Term: amend current contract to add 1-year staged uplift (Aug 1 start)
- Capacity: +50% sustained throughput; burst allowance retained
- Pricing: see MAP (proposed tiered effective rate after commit)
- Onboarding: 2-week technical ramp + 30-day performance SLO review

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the primary procurement contact and vendor PO timeline.
2) Can you confirm Aug 1 as target go-live for the uplift? If procurement needs a later start we can model pro-rated charges.
3) Who from Vectra should we invite to the QBR to sign off on capacity targets (exec + engineering recommended)? Suggested: Ava Lang (you), Alex Rivera (Eng), and Procurement mailbox.

Proposed QBR windows (all next week, ET):
- Tue Jul 20: 10:00–10:45 ET
- Wed Jul 21: 15:00–15:45 ET
- Thu Jul 22: 11:00–11:45 ET

If any of those work, I’ll lock a calendar invite and include the draft MAP and a short agenda (rollout milestones, provisioning, success metrics, sign-off).

Thanks — I’ll await a quick confirmation so we can route legal and CS.

Best,
Logan Wright
